hero.h1: TikTok Transcript API – Straight From the Audio
hero.subtitle: Turn TikToks into text from your own code. Send a public link and get back what is actually said — transcribed from the audio, so it works whether or not the creator added captions.

quickAnswer.question: Does TikTok have a transcript API?
quickAnswer.answer: No. TikTok's developer APIs need approval for specific use cases and do not return the transcript of any public video. TranscriptX does it from a link: send the URL, get the spoken text with timestamps, in over 100 languages.

sections.h2: Why the Audio, Not the Captions
content: Many creators never add captions, auto-captions are not always on, and on-screen text rarely matches what is said. Reading captions leaves gaps.
TranscriptX listens to the video itself. Speech is separated from music and trending sounds, and each voice in a duet or stitch is labelled.

items.content: Track what creators say about a brand or category, not just their hashtags.
Collect the scripts of viral videos and compare how they open.
Review what a creator says before a partnership.
Feed transcripts to an LLM, or let an agent fetch them via MCP.

items.q: Do I need a TikTok account?
items.a: No. Just the public video link and a TranscriptX API key.
Over 100, detected automatically — a mixed feed needs no per-request settings.

items.q: Is there a version without code?

content: Any public TikTok, captioned or not. Tracking other platforms too? See the [Instagram Transcript API](/instagram-transcript-api) or the [Transcription API](/transcription-api).
